title: Shopify replaced Redis with MySQL for inventory reservations–and it scaled
summary: Shopify engineers replaced their Redis-based inventory reservation system with MySQL, achieving better scalability while reducing infrastructure complexity and operational overhead for their high-volume e-commerce platform.
problem_solved: Scaling inventory reservation system to handle high-volume concurrent operations while maintaining consistency and performance.
why_valuable: Demonstrates that traditional relational databases can outperform specialized solutions at scale, offering simpler operations and reduced costs for inventory management use cases.
